notes: Every flag thrown on the team in League games, declined and offsetting included; `accepted` and yards count accepted flags only.
phase: the feed marks pre-snap vs live ball; dead ball is ours -- unsportsmanlike conduct, sideline interference, disqualification and equipment violations.
by_side: a flag on a kick play (punt, kickoff, field goal, try) is special_teams; otherwise offense or defense by whether the team had the ball.
unknown: the feed's garbled foul codes ("H0", "OS57", "PG"), not guessed at. A stacked foul ("X S U Y") counts under its first foul.
